text:
julia (AE): Opening SafeguardBank POC thread. Scope: SAML SSO (Okta primary), SCIM provisioning (users + nested groups), RBAC mapping from Okta groups to tenant roles, domain verification via DNS TXT preferred, and Private/VPC option for PHI. Buyer needs quick feasibility + short onboarding runbook + cost delta Dedicated vs Private by Tue. Looping in @dan and @sam.

dan (SE): Clarifying: SP-initiated + IdP-initiated both needed? Any OIDC client flows or just admin API access? Also, how big is their directory?

sam (Solutions Eng): They want both SAML flows. No OIDC for authn now. Admin APIs will use mTLS from their CI. Directory: ~22k users, ~1.5k groups, initial cutover target: 60 req/s sustained for 2 hours.

claire (Security): If PHI -> require customer-managed KMS and per-assertion audit retention. HSM optional but adds 3-5wk lead. Confirm retention window (90d vs 365d) — pricing differs. Also need SIEM forwarding details (Splunk HF preferred).

julia (AE): Pricing Q: they quoted 8M tokens/mo + 600k SCIM ops during onboarding. What's uplift for Dedicated vs Private (one-time + monthly)? Also ask: can we guarantee a 2-hr 60 req/s burst?

dan (SE): Default SCIM tenant rate is 10 req/s. We can approve scheduled bursts to 60 req/s for short windows with Ops notice (72h) and a safety cutoff. Cost: approx 1.25x for that window to cover ops & infra. Private will have higher setup fee but may lower marginal token cost; need committed qps to firm numbers.

sam (Solutions Eng): Technical mitigation: recommend bulk import path (CSV -> /scim/v2/Users/bulk) with chunking (250-500 users) to reduce request counts. If they insist on SCIM push at 60 req/s, require short-term rate change + monitoring. We'll include sample mapping rules (regex) in runbook.

dan (SE): Sample mapping snippet we will include:
```
{"rule":"group_regex","pattern":"^dept-(.+)$","role":"\\1"}
```

claire (Security): Add to runbook: KMS config steps, SIEM endpoint config, log redaction options for PII in assertions, and minimum evidence (SOC2 + penetration test summary). I'll draft a checklist.

julia (AE): Action items: @sam draft one-page runbook + mapping examples by EOD tomorrow; @dan run quick perf sim for 60 req/s using 2KB/user assumption and send 1-page estimate Dedicated vs Private; @claire provide compliance checklist and retention options. I'll request their sample SCIM CSV and target cutover times.

ops-bot: ticket#8123 created: "SafeguardBank onboarding window" assigned to oncall-ops. Note: require 72h notice for rate changes.

julia (AE): Thanks team — I'll update SafeguardBank and ask for CSV + confirm cutover window. :thumbsup:
